message.content:
An editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover for "TEMPO". The foreground features a man with dark skin, wearing a light-blue, long-sleeved shirt and dark pants, hunched over while supporting a massive, crescent-shaped wooden structure on his shoulders. This structure has a ridged, vertical-slat texture in brown and blue tones, resembling a stylized building roof. It towers over him, its pointed ends curving upwards. To the left, two smaller silhouettes of men in suits walk away across a landscape of cracked, parched earth. The sky is filled with soft blue and white clouds.

Text on the cover includes "TEMPO" in large white letters. Above it, "Korupsi Jual-Beli Gas PGN" and "Sana-sini Bermasalah Tapera" appear in black. Below the title, the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" is written in small white capitals. The main headline reads "KALANG KABUT IBU KOTA BARU" in bold black type. A paragraph of Indonesian text is positioned beneath the headline. A barcode, QR code, and publication details like "10-16 JUNI 2024" and "RP 50.000" are visible at the bottom.
